hero.headline: Building an outbound pipeline for an AI-powered medical tourism platform
hero.intro: With nearly two decades of experience in medical tourism dating back to 2006, the founder saw firsthand how difficult it is for international patients to find the right specialists, reports, and cross-border support. Building in the health-tech and medical travel space, the company leverages technology to simplify cross-border patient journeys while helping hospitals and partners manage enquiries, case coordination, and patient care.

challenge.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Medical travel is an exceptionally high-trust category. The stakeholders involved are not making everyday business software purchases: they are dealing with patients seeking critical treatments, referrals between specialists and hospitals, diagnostic reports, cultural expectations, and cross-border care delivery.

A generic product-led sales pitch would have immediately failed in this environment. The challenge was to systematically reach diverse roles across the medical travel ecosystem, pinpoint which audiences had genuine commercial appetite, and initiate consultative dialogues without making every interaction feel like another aggressive sales solicitation.

approach.heading: The Approach: Relevance, Segmentation & Conversation Before Conversion
approach.intro: Myntmore built the outbound architecture around precise audience segmentation, addressing distinct problems for each stakeholder group:

audiences.title: Referrals & Continuity
audiences.body: Approached around referral visibility, patient updates, and staying informed about their patients' care overseas.

audiences.title: Enquiry Quality & Conversion
audiences.body: Approached around incoming international patient enquiry quality, conversion rates, and streamlined cross-border case coordination.

audiences.title: Expectation Management
audiences.body: Approached around patient expectations, seamless logistics, and managing India-bound medical travel cases with clarity.

approach.openingText: In multiple campaigns, prospects were invited to share market perspectives, provide feedback, or explore becoming early platform partners. This made initial interactions frictionless and gave conversations organic momentum before introducing commercial terms.

messaging.heading: The Messaging Strategy
messaging.intro: Our messaging focused on opening authentic conversations rather than pushing immediate demo requests:

cards.title: Early Collaborator Positioning
cards.body: Prospects were invited as industry co-creators to provide domain input or explore pilot partnerships, significantly lowering defense mechanisms.

cards.title: Pattern-Disrupting Voice Notes
cards.body: Founder-led voice notes were deployed in selected follow-ups to break the rhythm of templated text outreach, humanizing the brand and revitalizing unreplied conversations.

items.title: High-intent ICPs outshine broad targeting
items.body: Hospital Decision Makers delivered a 61.59% response rate and 45 leads, validating the enormous leverage of addressing people directly responsible for international patient conversion.

items.title: Doctors provide pipeline scale
items.body: With 58 leads, doctors represented the largest opportunity base, even though their post-acceptance reply rate was naturally lower than dedicated administrative hospital staff.

items.title: Operational roles represent high-conversion assets
items.body: Business Development & Operations achieved a 59.74% response rate, and Operations & Partnerships reached 51.85%, highlighting that healthcare operational champions are eager for workflow solutions.

items.title: Specificity earns the meeting
items.body: Treating each cohort as a distinct conversation (referrals for doctors vs enquiry quality for hospital CEOs) eliminated generic messaging and dramatically lifted trust.

items.title: Earn the conversation before asking for the conversion
items.body: Leading with the prospect's real-world experience and introducing early collaboration before a commercial ask created an enduring, repeatable healthcare outbound playbook.
